neighbours.label: the verb 'help' / 'helps' (aid someone in doing something)
fire: Cold compresses can help reduce the swelling after surgery.

Reading aloud to children helps them learn new words.
The new software should help teachers track student progress.
Stretching before a run can help prevent muscle cramps.
My neighbour offered to help me carry the boxes upstairs.
quiet: Cold compresses are usually applied for ten minutes after surgery.

Volunteers came to watch the farmers bring in the harvest.
Reading aloud to children is a pleasant evening ritual.
The new software lets teachers track student progress.

My neighbour watched me carry the boxes upstairs.
